parse_macro_definitions: parse PDDM-DEFINE macro definitions from a text file into a MacroCollection
expand_macros: expand macro invocations like foo(a,b) using a MacroCollection and return substituted text
parse_source_file_sections: parse a source file into sections separating PDDM-DEFINE and PDDM-EXPAND blocks
process_source_content: process a source file to expand all PDDM-EXPAND blocks and return generated content
test_macro_recursion_detection: test that the PDDM macro system detects and raises errors on recursive macro invocations
